questions.text: Priya and Rakesh are entitled to interest on capital of Rs. 30,000 and Rs. 35,000 respectively. Interest on capital is an appropriation. The firm's profit for the year is only Rs. 16,250. The interest on capital actually allowed to Priya is:
questions.explanation: profit 16250 < total IOC 65000: allocate in IOC ratio Priya gets 16250 x 30000/65000 = Rs. 7,500  Correct option D. Distractors: A = allowed the full interest on capital despite the shortage; B = gave Priya the amount due to Rakesh; C = split the available profit equally.
